name: rd-ledger
description: Contemporaneous R&D time and AI-usage ledger: engagement hours by business component, list-price usage estimates, a weekly review with buttons, a CPA export, an optional bridge to rd-tracker, and a live Usage pane (cost, context, rate limits, models, subagents, code changes) behind one footer chip. Metadata only, nothing leaves the Mac.

footerButton.title: Footer chip opens Usage
footerButton.description: Draw the footer figure as a pressable chip under the composer (the desktop draws every button as a grey chip); a press opens the Usage pane with the R&D ledger as the tab beside it. Off, the figure is plain text and /rd usage opens the panes.

footerChip.title: Footer chip shows
footerChip.description: both: the session cost and today's R&D hours ('$123 ⧗2.4h'). cost: the session cost alone. time: today's R&D hours alone. The label stays within 16 characters.

chipContext.title: Context in the chip
chipContext.description: Also show the context window's fill (' · ctx 12%'). Off by default: within the 16-character bound the hours give way to it first, and the figure is one press away in the Usage pane.

refreshMinutes.title: Refresh every (minutes)
refreshMinutes.description: How often the week and month figures are recomputed from the session files. 1 to 60; default 5.

idleGapMinutes.title: Idle gap (minutes)
idleGapMinutes.description: Two prompts further apart than this start a new engagement block. 5 to 120; default 30, the canonical rd-tracker methodology. Changing it changes the method hash printed on every export.

cacheTtl.title: Prompt-cache write assumption
cacheTtl.description: The engine does not say whether a cache write was 5-minute (1.25x input price) or 1-hour (2x). Pick the one your sessions use; a session that reports its TTL overrides this.

rdtRepo.title: rd-tracker repository (absolute path)
rdtRepo.description: Leave empty to run standalone. With a path, the Review view shows rd-tracker's hours beside this ledger's, entities and components can be imported, and the bridge mode below applies.

bridgeMode.title: Bridge mode
bridgeMode.description: corroborate: this ledger writes nothing into rd-tracker and the review shows both. source-of-truth: confirming a week records its hours in rd-tracker through rdt add (double counts unless the nightly ingest excludes Claude Code). off: no rdt calls at all.

personLabel.title: Person label for exports
personLabel.description: Printed only in the export README's header (Person: …). Leave blank to print 'not recorded — add on cover sheet'. Never stored in the session records.
